# Quiet

> Quiet is a free iPhone app (iOS 17 or later) that shows Instagram's mobile website without Reels and Explore, and enforces a daily time limit that cannot be raised for the current day. Made by Connexa GmbH, Sirnach, Switzerland. Not affiliated with Instagram or Meta.

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6802907680
Website: https://marco-p-keller.github.io/Quiet/ (German: https://marco-p-keller.github.io/Quiet/de/)
Source code: https://github.com/Marco-P-Keller/Quiet

## What it does

- Feed, stories, direct messages and profile work as on Instagram's mobile site.
- Reels and Explore are removed. Suggested posts between friends' posts stay by default and can be hidden with one switch.
- Sign in happens on Instagram's own login page. Quiet never sees the password.
- The user picks a daily limit in minutes (minimum 5). Time counts only while the app is on screen. Notices at 5 minutes and 1 minute left. When time runs out the app closes until 4:00 in the morning.
- Lowering the limit works any time, immediately. Raising it is allowed once a week and starts the next day.
- The limit is stored in the iOS keychain, so reinstalling does not reset it. "Make Quiet forget everything" removes it after the same wait as a raise.

## What it does not do

- No account, no server, no analytics, no advertising, no tracking. App Store privacy label: Data Not Collected.
- It does not block Instagram's ads.
- No Android version.

## Good fit for people who

- want to keep Instagram for friends and messages but stop losing hours to Reels
- tried Screen Time limits and kept tapping "Ignore Limit"
- deleted Instagram before and reinstalled it

## Trade-offs

Runs on Instagram's mobile website, so pages load a little slower than the official app and some features are missing.

## Pricing

Free. No subscription, no in-app purchases.

## Languages

English, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil).
